gates: Independently review and freeze the actual compact source, canonical equivalence, exact input bytes, fee profile, actors, UUID refs and this plan before any signature.

Preserve the recorded default gas-estimation failures. A separately reviewed user-wallet transport may proceed only with the exact deployment request passing a fresh fixed-block eth_call, gas limited to 100000000, total protocol value plus maximum envelope gas at most 0.05 test GEN, complete network/source/fee/account/nonce checks, explicit user confirmation for one deployment, and durable uncertain-send recovery without automatic retry. This replaces only the interrupted run's default-estimate transport gate, not any business oracle or accepted-consensus requirement.

One zero-argument deployment only: verified finalized accepted RETURN, exact source/sender/empty args/non-leader-only/inclusion identity and zero baseline/order count plus both getters before order creation.

Execute cases 1..13 only first. Negative revision must read back INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, then genuine corrected revision ACCEPTED, with full snapshot/assessment projections and immutable revision-1 history before opening cases 14..51.
Every actual order ID must equal 1..9 as prelocked. Stop on a different ID; do not reassign IDs or recompute an oracle from chain observations.

Any model-oracle mismatch, nonaccepted consensus, timeout or UNDETERMINED stops remaining writes. Do not resample or silently resubmit; preserve every attempted hash/unknown send outcome and inspect history.

Expected ERROR transactions must themselves finalize with accepted consensus, verified inclusion, exact target/args/sender identity and before/after readback equality. A request rejected before any hash is not that signed-case proof.
All ten assessments compare all nine finding fields, field checks, basis/scope, nulls, source checks, verdict and snapshot hash. Reasons are structurally checked and do not select an oracle.

Source verification performs two GETs and zero models per independent execution; model assessment performs zero HTTP, including failed source and missing optional branches. Initial model counts are per independent side, not a claim about total private committee executions.
Only after all 51 case proofs and independent readback audit may publication/default deployment and ZIP be considered. No Portal form is filled or submitted by this plan.
migration: This is a new V6 business lifecycle plan, not an edit to the frozen diagnostic or failed deployment plans.

The V6 code-owned catalog version, natural question criterion text and label-rendered unknown body are an explicit schema/text migration. Factual statements and the two source materials are retained byte-for-byte except the new optional factual controls and deliberate malformed guards.
Catalog fields are unique, same-group and independent of criterion ID; factual-only/custom boundary criteria have no field IDs. Strict/allow is not exposed to model prompts.
The old b931 five successful unsigned pairs support its limited diagnostic policy only; they are not V6 business or public committee passes.

The blocked nonzero-constructor original and compact transport attempts, their inputs, actual errors and plans remain unchanged. This zero-argument staged V6 lifecycle replaces the previously proposed isolated-constructor committee phase; it does not mark that phase complete.

Optional submitted facts must be sufficiently established. Any submitted optional insufficiency, failed source or strict unknown requires revision; an omitted optional item is MISSING/null and may be ignored. Required items retain their stronger veto.

A separate v6-wallet-2 execution run follows user correction of the public wallet address prior to deployment. All 51 signing roles use the corrected user-controlled wallet; fresh references and dependent commitments are recomputed offline from the oracle engine rather than mutating v6-wallet-1 JSON files.
offlineOnlyCoverage: The 34 canonical V6 and 39 compact equivalence tests use stubs, not real GenVM/model proof.

One criterion, six criteria, empty claims/sources, source encodings/limits, actor/current-revision checks, five-revision bound, nonadjacent content replay, malformed leaders, full projection tampering and global repair/result preservation are local controls, not additional signed cases in this 51-case suite.
A single immutable snapshot includes failures. Transient unavailability is locked for that revision; this suite does not add source retries or an abandon mechanism.
The initial 6+1 model allowance and 600/600 fee allocations are development limits, not measured production worst-case calibration.
